UserAppState.title: UserAppState
UserAppState.description: The complete financial state of a user containing transactions, cards, and budgets.

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

transactions.description: JSON stringified list of user transactions.

creditCards.description: JSON stringified list of credit cards.

debitCards.description: JSON stringified list of debit cards.

installments.description: JSON stringified list of installment purchases.

categories.description: JSON stringified list of budgeting categories.

deletedGeneratedIds.description: JSON stringified list of deleted automatic transaction IDs.

initialBalancesOverrides.description: JSON stringified map of initial balance overrides.

updatedAt.description: The server-validated timestamp of the last write.

/userStates/{userId}.description: A single comprehensive state document for each user to enable instant real-time synchronization between devices without query latency.
